answer_1.quote: We treat canonical segmentation as a sequence-to-sequence problem and use a character-level pointer-generator LSTM to map each surface form word to its segmented, canonicalized form.
datasets: SIGMORPHON 2023 Shared Task on Interlinear Glossing data

answer_2.quote: We employ three common metrics for evaluation. The first is whole-word accuracy... character-level edit distance... modified F1 score...
